The 2027 Coachmen Galleria 24Q is built for the whole crew. Its signature quad captain's chairs give four travelers a comfortable, forward-facing seat with a removable table dropped in between, perfect for a card game at the campsite, a working lunch on a travel day, or just watching the country roll by together. Riding on the award-winning Mercedes-Benz Sprinter chassis with a clean-running turbo-diesel and 9-speed automatic, the 24Q pairs that flexibility with the fuel economy, refinement, and available all-wheel-drive capability that make the Sprinter platform the benchmark of the Class B segment. Mercedes driver-assist technology, blind spot monitoring, lane assist, collision avoidance, electronic stability program, and a back-up camera. At just 24' 3' long, the Galleria 24Q parks like a van, drives like a car, and camps like a coach.
